Apple TV announced today that the French-language series "Carême" has been renewed for a second season. Details below.

Apple TV renews "Carême"

Apple TV announced this morning that "Carême," starring Benjamin Voisin, has been renewed for a second season and is expected to begin filming in Paris next week.

"Carême" premiered last April with a total of 8 episodes and holds an average rating of 7.9/10 on IMDb. Adapted from Ian Kelly's work "Carême: The First Celebrity Chef," the series is currently nominated for an International Emmy Award in the drama category, as well as two Hollywood Music in Media Awards (HMMA) for original score and original main title theme.

The 54th International Emmy Awards ceremony will be held in New York on November 23, while the 17th HMMA was held in Hollywood a few days ago (November 18).
